contract.intent: Read, write, validate, and selectively query the committed Drift contract index store used as the baseline for checks, diffs, proof reports, and ESLint.

must_not_change: Runtime-only extraction fields must not be written to the committed index.
Missing index stores must be treated as absent, not invalid.
Generated index stores must remain deterministic, sharded, and Git-readable.
Scoped workflows must read contracts by file or id instead of requiring a full index materialization.
